context: Fixed field-reported stop-hook loop and two adjacent losses (#43/#44/#45): marker-based stop gate (plugin 1.16.0), gitignore reconcile for existing stores, dead-letter queue for pending drain. 1221 tests green.
rationale: Field diagnosis with the live binary proved mtime is a leaky proxy: concurrent worktrees bump untracked-dir mtimes after recording (unwinnable race), touch/checkout/formatters bump without recordable work, and the alphabetical head-200 cap produced false ALLOW and false BLOCK from the same state. The marker measures the actual gated question — did THIS session edit files after its last record. Supersedes the 1.10.0 sentinel-vs-mtime mechanism while preserving its fail-open doctrine and transcript-free rule; also restores the original 2026-05-05 judgment (01KQWCCVTV) that rejected mtime before 1.10.0 reintroduced it. Field recommendations A (exclude .claude/**) and B (fix head-cap) became moot — the dirty scan no longer exists.
summary: Stop gate signal replaced: per-session activity marker (PostToolUse Edit/Write → .twining/.sessions/<session_id>) compared against the record sentinel, replacing the dirty-file-mtime scan
